violations.description: Release workflow lacks minimum-privilege permissions block
violations.evidence: .github/workflows/release.yml has permissions block with only id-token: [REDACTED], but lacks top-level contents: read permissions or job-level explicit permissions for other tasks (though uses checkout@v3).
violations.recommendation: Add explicit top-level or job-level permissions specifying contents: read and id-token: [REDACTED] to adhere to principle of least privilege.
